evals.prompt: Create a 16:9 ArcheBase investor slide with one evidence-led judgment, using the official VI Guide color system. Explain which color ratio and typography evidence you used, which logo asset you selected, and what remains unresolved before release.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the deck and PDF evidence references, uses the explicit 50/25/10/5 color mapping without inventing component-level semantics, uses the official V2 logo, cites Guide pages, and reports unresolved approvals plus a release verdict.
expectations: The response cites p.28 for the explicit 50/25/10/5 color ratio and maps the four colors correctly.
The response cites p.26 for the displayed Chinese/Latin type specimens and does not invent exact font licensing or CSS weights.
The response selects an asset from the bundled V2 logo set and does not redraw or edit the mark.
The response includes unresolved approvals, QA gates and a release verdict.

evals.prompt: Review a proposed ArcheBase web dashboard screen: it uses #0032FF, #7172FA, #619AFD and #46CFFF, a dark #1E2124 background, a white gradient logo, and a small caption. Tell me what is compliant, what needs correction, and what must be confirmed from the VI Guide.
evals.expected_output: The review distinguishes explicit PDF evidence from implementation decisions, checks the logo against V2 assets, checks neutral/text levels, and blocks unresolved claims instead of guessing.
expectations: The response recognizes the four colors and the p.28 ratio as explicit evidence but does not assume the ratio is a per-component requirement.
The response recognizes p.30–32 neutral levels and distinguishes confirmed percentages from unconfirmed compositing/context.
The response checks the logo variant through the resolver and enforces asset immutability.
The response returns concrete findings with source pages, owners/impact for unresolved items, and a verdict.

evals.prompt: We need a social graphic using a generated robot image, the phrase 'WISDOM BUILDS INTELLIGENCE', a customer metric, and the ArcheBase logo. Give the production checklist and identify any blockers.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads the social and image-generation playbooks, uses p.27 phrase evidence, checks rights/provenance/claims, forbids generated logos/text, and blocks publication until unresolved approvals are assigned.
expectations: The response cites p.27 for the phrase and does not generate the logo or on-image text.
The response requires provenance, image/customer/third-party rights and a source for the metric.
The response checks crops, first-frame legibility, official logo selection and asset immutability.
The response names blockers and gives a release verdict rather than treating the graphic as automatically publishable.

evals.prompt: Lay out an ArcheBase technical WeChat article in InkPost using the tracked CSS theme. Keep the VI style consistent and tell me what you would validate before copying it to WeChat.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects the inkpost-wechat route, uses the tracked preset as source, cites approved VI colors and typography evidence, runs CSS and WeChat safety checks, inspects the rendered article, and reports unresolved approvals plus a verdict.
expectations: The response distinguishes the tracked InkPost preset from local user theme state.
The response uses the explicit VI color evidence without turning p.28 into component quotas.
The response requires deterministic CSS validation and rendered preview inspection before release.
The response reports claims, rights, naming, type and export blockers instead of guessing.
